title: fix(import): tessellate three-fillet corner blends instead of refusing them
body:
## What changed

A STEP solid whose rounded edges meet in corner blends now imports closed, instead of being refused by #1546's guard (or, before that, hanging: #1536).

The issue assumed truck cannot subdivide the blends because they are not continuous. They are continuous. I rebuilt the #1536 model from the issue's description with solidcore (two L-shaped halves united, all 30 edges rounded R3.125, written by its step-export): 1 shell, 62 faces, 126 edges, 66 vertices, as the issue lists, and the same refusal on d569372f. Two separate faults were measured on it.

**1. The pole (root cause of the hang and of the refusal).** The corner blend is a rational Bezier patch of degree (4, 2) with one side collapsed to the corner vertex. Every parameter along that side is a pre-image of the vertex. truck finds a boundary point's parameters by Newton iteration; at the pole the free parameter came back as **-1,195,342,517** (knot domain 0..1), which truck accepts because the extrapolated rational surface still passes through the vertex. It then subdivides the bounding box of the boundary's parameters: a billion knot spans of extrapolation, which never meets the tolerance. On the knot domain itself the same subdivision ends in 3 to 5 rounds at every tolerance of the schedule.

- New `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step_pole.rs`. The metered surface (`step_guard`) post-processes truck's parameter searches for B-spline and NURBS faces. An answer inside the knot domain is returned untouched. One outside it is replaced by a parameter inside the domain (the previous boundary point's value for each coordinate that left it, else the nearest bound), but only when the surface there is the searched point (truck's own 1e-6). Anything else is left as truck found it, still bounded by #1546's meter.

**2. The edges (a silent wrong mesh behind the refusal).** With the pole fixed alone, the model imported in 2.4 s with no refusal and was wrong: **13,981 mm3 of 19,549.7**, every planar face missing a corner. The rounded edges are `SURFACE_CURVE`s whose master is `.PCURVE_S1.`; truck rebuilds such an edge as a 2D curve on the neighbouring surface, in its own parametrisation of that surface and between parameters it searches for without a hint.

- New `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step_edge3d.rs`. Before the shells are converted, every `EDGE_CURVE` on a surface curve is pointed at that curve's `curve_3d`. Switching only the master to `.CURVE_3D.` is not enough: for an edge with `same_sense = .F.` truck 0.3.0 inverts the curve twice on that path (pinned below).

No new tessellator: truck's subdivision is kept, so no other B-spline face changes its mesh. The issue's three options and why they were dropped are in `docs/decisions/1548-bspline-corner-blends.md`.

## Readings

Debug build. "Closed" means 0 unmatched edges.

| Model | Result |
|---|---|
| #1536 part rebuilt, 62 faces, on d569372f | refused: "face #14010 (NURBS surface, face 19 of 62 ...) did not converge" |
| same, with this PR | 33,073 facets, closed, **19,545.21 mm3** (stated 19,549.71; the 4.5 mm3 is the inscribed mesh's chord error), 1.3 s |
| same, every edge reversed (`same_sense = .F.`), with this PR | identical: 33,073 facets, closed, 19,545.21 mm3 |
| same, face senses turned, with this PR | 33,236 facets, 19,545.21 mm3. Counted with an earlier rounding-based edge count only: it showed 20 edges, in pairs one rounding step apart (the same point either side of a step). Not re-counted with the welding count the test uses. |
| 30 mm cube, all 12 edges R3.125, on d569372f | imported with no refusal at **14,993 mm3** (57% of the closed form 26,286.4) |
| the same cube written with solidcore's opt-in fixes on, with this PR | 15,820 facets, closed, 26,281.69 mm3. (The cube file of the row above was not re-run after the fix.) |
| `fillet_corner.step` (the fixture), with this PR | imports closed, volume inside the test's bound around the closed form 26,816.49 mm3 |
| the fixture, with this PR but without the pole rule | refused: "face #1228 (NURBS surface, face 2 of 10 ...) did not converge" (mutation 1 below) |

The gate's suites over the existing STEP fixtures are green (below).

## How tested

New fixture `testdata/models/fillet_corner.step` (76 KB): the #1536 part's size, a 30 mm cube centred on the origin, with the three edges at (-15, -15, -15) rounded R3.125. Three cylinders and one corner blend; 12 of its 21 edges are surface curves with a pcurve master. Generated with solidcore (recipe below), face senses turned outward.

Mutation checks: each mutation applied, the test seen RED, then restored and seen GREEN.

| Test | Pins | Mutation | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `import_step_corner_blend::a_three_fillet_corner_imports_closed_at_its_volume_within_the_chord_tolerance` | default cap, 120 s hard limit; bounds; 0 unmatched edges; volume short of the closed form by 0 ..= 0.005 mm x curved area; `coarse_mm` is `None` | `settle` not applied in the two metered searches | RED: refused, "face #1228 (NURBS surface, face 2 of 10 in shell #1288) ... did not converge within 25000000 evaluations" |
| same | same | `prefer_3d` not called | RED: 24 unmatched edges |
| `import_step_corner_blend::edges_declared_against_their_curves_import_the_same_closed_solid` | every edge rewritten with its vertices swapped and `same_sense = .F.` imports the same solid | edges left on their surface curve (master switched only) | RED: 74 unmatched edges |
| `step_pole::tests::an_outside_answer_that_is_not_a_pole_is_left_as_truck_found_it` | the only guard in the rule: no replacement unless it is the same point | same-point check removed | RED: `(1.0, 0.9)` instead of `(1.0, 2.0)` (also fails `a_non_finite_answer_ends_cleanly`) |
| `step_pole::tests::a_pole_answer_far_outside_takes_the_previous_boundary_points_parameter` | the -1.2e9 reading goes to the previous point's parameter | hint not carried | RED: `(0.0, 0.0)` instead of `(0.0, 1.0)` |
| `step_pole::tests::{an_answer_inside_the_knot_domain_is_returned_untouched, a_pole_answer_with_no_usable_hint_goes_to_the_nearer_domain_bound, a_surface_without_knots_is_never_touched, a_non_finite_answer_ends_cleanly}` | the rest of the rule | - | - |
| `import_step_corner_blend::bent_corner_blends_end_cleanly_and_bounded` | 10 variants of the blend (zero, negative and 1E300 weights; reversed, zero-length, 1E300 and -1E9 knots; the pole pulled apart): each imports finite facets or is refused, inside 90 s | - (degenerate-input pin) | - |

This PR adds no new refusal. Faces that still cannot be subdivided keep #1546's refusal by name (`import_step_guard`, unchanged and green).

Gate on the final head fd1a1c94 (merged with upstream/main f1de41a5):
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green, 56 s. App lib plus bore_facet_sagitta, import_step_corner_blend, import_step_guard, large_models, model_fidelity, step_budget, step_chord_units, step_fidelity, step_nesting, stock_export: 252 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored. (The planner mapped the change to these suites; it did not fall back to batch.)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test import`: 26 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings`: clean.

## Not exercised

- **The user's own `sc_logo.step` was not available.** The readings are on a rebuild of that part with solidcore at the pinned rev 55d0e76 with all opt-in fixes on. The topology counts match the issue, but the writer is not the same: the issue's file has 14 spheres and 20 B-spline surfaces, the rebuild 14 rational patches and 6 surfaces of revolution. Please re-run the #1536 repro on a build of this branch; expected is a closed mesh near 19,545 mm3.
- The rebuilt 62-face model and the full rounded cube are not committed (1 MB and 365 KB); only the one-corner fixture is.
- **A closed shell that meshes open is still not refused.** Three bent variants in the fuzz test import with the blend face dropped (138 facets, open). Filed as #1573 (P1).
- Edge-curve and swept-surface divisions and the parameter searches are still unmetered (#1545; one slow reading added there).
- The GUI import path was not run by hand; it calls the same `parse_with_chord_budget`.
- Release-mode timings were not measured.

<details><summary>Fixture recipe (scratch crate, not committed)</summary>

Dependencies: `solidcore` and `step-export` from `https://github.com/NeoTech/solidcore` at rev `55d0e7638b9e1ebbf91ab8c10657e595c114ecda` (the rev `crates/kernel` pins).

```rust
let mut k = solidcore::Kernel::default();
k.fixes = solidcore::kernel::UpstreamFixes::all();
let mut b = prim::create_box(&mut k, Point3::new(-15.0, -15.0, -15.0), 30.0, 30.0, 30.0)?;
// the three edges with an end at (-15, -15, -15)
let edges: Vec<EdgeId> = /* b.edges() filtered by curve end points */;
fillet_edges(&mut k, &mut b, &edges, 3.125, 1, 1, 1.0)?;
let text = step_export::write(&step_export::brep_to_model(&b)?)?;
```

Then every `ADVANCED_FACE` sense and every `FACE_OUTER_BOUND` orientation is flipped (the writer's senses came out inward), and `FILE_DESCRIPTION` is replaced. The 62-face model is the same with four boxes united into the two L halves and all 30 edges rounded.
</details>

Changelog: STEP import: a solid whose rounded edges meet in corner blends (three-fillet corners) now imports closed at its volume instead of being refused; edges written as surface curves with a pcurve master are read from their 3D curve (#1548)

Effort: max (not escalated)

Builds on #1546, which merged while this was in work; the branch carries a merge of upstream/main f1de41a5.
